changes.title: Trump's threat to push ahead on settlement fund injects new uncertainty into attorney general talks
changes.summary: Trump asserted in a Truth Social post that he would keep acting Attorney General Todd Blanche in his current role and press ahead on the "Anti-Weaponization Fund" if Sens. John Cornyn and Thom Tillis refuse to back Blanche.
